DOC-DERIVED FIXTURES - NOT CAPTURED FROM A DEVICE
=================================================

These files are reconstructions of VOSS / Fabric Engine 9.3-9.4 output shapes
taken from Extreme's published command references, NOT from a real switch.
They exist to pin behaviour the parsers must survive (channelized sub-port
ranges in particular), not to certify that a 9.x box prints exactly this.

Column widths, footers and any extra columns a release may add are the parts
most likely to be wrong here. Replace each file with a real `--save-raw`
capture as soon as one is available, and keep the tests.
